studyTitle: A trial looking at stopping heart medication for people who have heart problems caused by cancer treatment (STOP-MED CTRCD)
studySummary: This trial is looking at whether it is safe for people to stop heart medication after finishing their cancer treatment.

studyTitle: A trial of trastuzumab deruxtecan for people with oesophageal, stomach or gastro oesophageal junction cancer (DECIPHER)
studySummary: This trial is looking at trastuzumab deruxtecan after surgery. It’s for people with cancer of the:

studyTitle: A study looking at improving treatment for children with kidney cancer (UMBRELLA PLUS)
cancerType: Children's cancers, Kidney cancer, Renal cell cancer, Wilms tumour
studySummary: This study will collect information about children with kidney (renal) cancers, including Wilms tumour, to help with decisions about treatment in the future.

studyTitle: A trial looking at BEP chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumours (UKP3BEP)
cancerType: Children's cancers, Ovarian cancer, Testicular cancer
studySummary: This trial is for people with a germ cell tumour that has spread (metastatic). It is for people who have a germ cell tumour of one of the following:

studyTitle: A study looking at high resolution ultrasound to diagnose prostate cancer
studySummary: This study is looking at using 2 different contrast mediums used in ultrasounds that might give a better picture of the prostate.

studyTitle: A trial looking at DTP3 for lymphoma or myeloma
cancerType: Blood cancers, High grade lymphoma, Lymphoma, Myeloma, Non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL)
studySummary: This trial is looking at a new drug called DTP3 for diffuse large B cell lymphoma or myeloma.

studyTitle: A trial looking at how often to give pembrolizumab for non small lung cancer (REFINE-Lung)
cancerType: Lung cancer, Non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), Secondary cancers
studySummary: This trial is looking at whether it is possible to give pembrolizumab less often for advanced non small lung cancer.

studyTitle: A trial looking at treatment after surgery for womb cancer (RAINBO NSMP-ORANGE)
studySummary: This trial is looking at radiotherapy and hormone therapy after surgery for womb cancer. It is comparing this to standard treatment with chemotherapy and radiotherapy after surgery.

studyTitle: A trial using PSMA PET-CT scans to guide treatment for prostate cancer (IP-10 AVIDITY)
studySummary: This trial is looking at whether doctors can use PSMA PET-CT scans to guide treatment for people who have high risk prostate cancer. High risk prostate cancer is cancer that is more likely to grow quickly or spread.

studyTitle: A trial of radiotherapy and targeted treatment for non small cell lung cancer (CONCORDE)
cancerType: Lung cancer, Non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
studySummary: This trial is to find the best dose of certain targeted drugs to give alongside radiotherapy for people with non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

studyTitle: A trial of aspirin to reduce the risk of cancer in people with primary sclerosing cholangitis (Asp-PSC)
cancerType: Bile duct cancer, Biliary tree cancers, Bowel (colorectal) cancer, Gallbladder cancer, Liver cancer
studySummary: This trial is looking at aspirin to reduce the risk of cancer, liver disease and the need for a liver transplant.

studyTitle: A trial looking at ginisortamab for advanced pancreatic cancer that has spread
studySummary: This trial is looking at adding a new drug called ginisortamab to chemotherapy for pancreatic cancer that has spread to other parts of the body. It is also looking at ginisortamab in combination with another drug called cobimetinib after chemotherapy.

studyTitle: A trial looking at rilvegostomig and trastuzumab deruxtecan for advanced stomach or gastro oesophageal junction cancer (ARTEMIDE-Gastric01)
cancerType: Oesophageal cancer, Secondary cancers, Stomach cancer
studySummary: This trial is looking at rilvegostomig and trastuzumab deruxtecan for cancer that has spread.

studyTitle: A trial looking at aspirin, metformin and resveratrol to prevent bowel polyps (COLO-PREVENT)
cancerType: Bowel (colorectal) cancer, Colon cancer, Rectal cancer
studySummary: This trial is looking at aspirin by itself and in combination with metformin to prevent bowel polyps. The researchers are also looking at a food supplement called resveratrol to see if this can prevent bowel polyps.

studyTitle: A trial looking at when to give radiotherapy for advanced lung cancer (PRINCE)
cancerType: Lung cancer, Non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), Secondary cancers
studySummary: This trial is looking at the best time to have radiotherapy to the chest for people with non small cell lung cancer that has spread.

studyTitle: A study looking at a new type of MRI scan for liver cancer (INTERIOR)
studySummary: This study is looking at a new type of MRI scan to improve stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy for liver cancer.
